value.rationale: The motivating 2026 study observes finite-size collapse at (alpha-1) log N and supplies a perturbative expansion, but a finite nonzero window requires nonperturbative control. The result gives the complete limiting distribution, explicit variance and Binder crossover over the entire fixed real window parameter, and correlations, explaining observable switching between diffuse and ballistic-like profiles. This answers a natural precise finite-size question rather than simply renaming the classical fixed-exponent Beta law.
